oneLine: Ventive Hospitality is in talks to acquire 2-3 luxury hotels.

sources.title: Ventive Hospitality in talks to acquire 2-3 luxury hotels

synopsis: Ventive Hospitality, a listed hospitality joint venture between Panchshil Realty and Blackstone, is in discussions to acquire two to three large luxury hotels in India, each expected to deliver an EBITDA of over Rs 100 crore, according to CEO Ranjit Batra. The company is pursuing these potential acquisitions alongside organic developments to expand its portfolio from 14 operational assets and roughly 2,200 keys toward a target of 4,000-plus keys. Previously, Ventive Hospitality agreed to acquire 100% of Kelzai Eco Reserves Private Limited for Rs 281.88 crore in cash at an enterprise value of Rs 466 crore. Additionally, the company must bring its promoter ownership down from 89% to meet the 25% public float requirement under SEBI rules by December 2027, evaluating options such as a QIP or an OFS.
